purpose: Teach: 和平/冥福/旺盛/平穏/献身/憎しみ/推論/分泌

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、警察、和平的解決を目指しております
lines.en: We're working toward a peaceful resolution in this matter.
lines.style: Measured, official but not cold. Even cadence. The composure of someone used to difficult conversations. Slight pause before 'peaceful' — choosing the word deliberately.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者のご冥福をお祈り申し上げます
lines.en: On behalf of the department, we offer our sincere condolences to the victim's family.
lines.style: Formal but genuine. The weight of duty in the voice. No rush. Each phrase lands with respect. A moment held at the end, as if the words matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の旺盛な犯行動機を警察、把握ですね
lines.en: So the department has a clear picture of the suspect's motivation in this case?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, not challenging. Leans forward slightly in tone. Ren testing whether he understands correctly, inviting clarity. Warm undertone — not interrogating.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、平穏な地域を取り戻すべく尽力しております
lines.en: The department is committed to restoring peace and safety to the community.
lines.style: Steady and resolved. Speaks from conviction about the work itself, not performance. Professional but personal — this is what matters. Slight emphasis on 'restoring.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者ご家族の献身的なご協力に警察も感謝です
lines.en: The victim's family has been remarkably cooperative, and the department is truly grateful for that.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation. Slows slightly on 'remarkably.' Recognition that this family's help matters. Sincere without ceremony. A nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の憎しみの動機を分析しております
lines.en: We're analyzing the suspect's underlying motivation — what drove this hatred.
lines.style: Methodical, thinking aloud slightly. Pause before 'hatred' — acknowledging the weight of it. Clinical but not distant. The voice of someone trained to examine without flinching.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、合理的な推論を進めておられますね
lines.en: The department seems to be building a sound logical framework here.
lines.style: Impressed, almost to himself. Recognizing the work being done. Respectful acknowledgment. Ren's approval is understated but genuine — the voice of someone who appreciates rigor.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、薬物分泌の医学的解析も依頼しております
lines.en: We've also requested a medical analysis of the substance involved.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, transitioning to detail. Closer, more intimate than before — sharing the next step. Technical but still grounded. No distance between Takeda and Ren now.
